I saved Hollis's correction: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Fieldworks is 87 seats. The note says it replaces this morning's 268.

So both entries are there now, with 87 as the newer correction. Someone with direct access to the brain can remove the old entry (fact #1).

I replied to Hollis in the thread on his message: 87 is saved, and I mentioned the leftover 268 entry. A seat count isn't a money figure, so it needed no approval.
